about: Golden references: each render in this crate's golden suite stored as a 24-bit FLAC file. render_hash is an FNV-1a hash of the 32-bit float render the reference was made from. The tests null-test every render against its reference: bit-exact on the platform in made_on, below -96 dBFS elsewhere. Change references only with `cargo xtask golden --update`, and say why in the pull request.
